summary: Reiterates the assignment of IPv4 block 192.0.0.0/24 to IANA and instructs IANA to restructure its IPv4 and IPv6 Special-Purpose Address Registries so that all special-purpose blocks are recorded with a common set of information. It is a Best Current Practice.

eli5.summary: Some addresses are saved for special jobs. This tells the keeper of the list to write down every saved address in the same neat way.

questions: what are special-purpose ip address blocks
where is the iana special-purpose address registry
